title: Patti Smith, Morrissey, Interpol, Violet Grohl and Sex Pistols to Play 2026 CBGB Festival
summary: Bikini Kill, Buzzcocks, Mannequin Pussy and others are also lined up for the September event at Under the K Bridge Park in Brooklyn.
contentText:
The 2026 edition of the CBGB Festival will feature a mix of classic and contemporary punk and new wave acts, topped by former Smiths singer and solo performer Morrissey, as well as punk godmother Patti Smith, Interpol and the Sex Pistols, featuring charter members guitarist Steve Jones, bassist Glen Matlock and drummer Paul Cook, with singer Frank Carter subbing in for OG vocalist Johnny Rotten/John Lydon.

The event honoring the legendary punk club in New York’s East Village that beginning in 1973 was the launching pad for the first wave of American punk acts such as the Ramones, Smith, Television, Blondie and the Talking Heads, among many others, will take place on Sept. 26 at Under the K Bridge Park in Brooklyn.

Also on this year’s bill, classic acts Bikini Kill, Agnostic Front, Buzzcocks, Circle Jerks and Haywire, as well as contemporary acts keeping the flame alive such as Upchuck, Militarie Gun, High Vis, Bad Nerves and Panic Shack. Violet Grohl, daughter of Foo Fighters frontman Dave Grohl, will take the stage to perform songs from her upcoming debut album, Be Sweet to Me (May 29). Also slated to perform is The Return of Jackie and Judy, the Ramones tribute band featuring Sleater-Kinney and SNL vet and drummer Fred Armisen.

“Building on last year’s CBGB Festival, we’ve worked hard to create an even stronger experience for fans this year,” said CBGB’s Phil Sandhaus in a statement. “For decades, CBGB defined the punk scene and helped shape a generation of music lovers in New York and beyond. This year’s lineup honors that legacy while celebrating the past, present, and future of punk and alternative music. No other festival on the East Coast offers that.”

Last year’s festival featured headliners Iggy Pop and Jack White, along with former Smiths guitarist and solo performer Johnny Marr, former Ramones drummer Marky Ramone, the Damned, Melvins, Gorilla Biscuits, Murphy’s Law, Cro-Mags, The Linda Lindas, Lambrini Girls and more.

Fans can register now for presale access to ticket here ; presale tickets go live on Thursday (April 23) at 10 a.m. ET, followed by a public on sale beginning on Friday (April 24) at 10 a.m. ET here .
